how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-blackrock-spire-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:4701:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Blackrock Spire and destroy the source of the worg menace. As you left Helendis, he shouted a name: ⟦E2⟧. It is what the orcs refer to in regards to the worg.
rows.quest:4701:details:0: You have no doubt seen the worgs which the Blackrock orcs command.
rows.quest:4701:details:1: BIt is curious - no matter how many we destroy, their numbers never dwindle. My scouts have reported that the worgs are bred, trained, and ultimately exported from Blackrock Spire: capital city of the Blackrock orcs. You must travel to Blackrock Spire and discover the source of this menace. Discover... and destroy.
rows.quest:4701:details:2: BGood luck, ⟦1⟧. May Cenarius protect you...⟦2⟧
rows.quest:4701:completion:0: Do not dwell upon her suffering, ⟦3⟧. The beast was corrupt - a product of dark magic. You have done the ⟦E3⟧ a great service and you shall be rewarded.
rows.quest:4724:obj:0: Slay ⟦E2⟧, pack mistress of the Bloodaxe worg.
rows.quest:4724:details:0: Some say the worg controlled by the Blackrock orcs are the creation of a supernatural force. Others say they are not true worg but instead a breed of demon dog, granted to the orcs by a fallen pit lord.
rows.quest:4724:details:1: BThe truth is far less contrived but every bit as frightening. The worg of Blackrock come from ⟦E2⟧ and her mate. ⟦E2⟧ is the gigantic den mother of the worg. Her mate? Nobody has ever lived to tell the tale of that one.
rows.quest:4724:details:2: BStrike at the heart of the worg. Destroy ⟦E2⟧... and ⟦4⟧, watch your back.
rows.quest:4724:completion:0: Rabid pups? Gizrul the Slavener? And you live to tell the tale?! Incredible! A tribute well earned!
rows.quest:4729:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Blackrock Spire and find Bloodaxe Worg Pups. Use the cage to carry the ferocious little beasts. Bring back a Caged Worg Pup to Kibler.
rows.quest:4729:details:0: You're probably wondering what I'm doing out here. Look at the cages! Ain't it obvious?
rows.quest:4729:details:1: BI'm an animal lover, first and foremost, but a salesman by trade. I track down exotic animals for the rich and famous and domesticate the beasts so they behave as proper pets.
rows.quest:4729:details:2: BNow you're probably wondering, "What can I do for you, Kibler." The answer is simple: Take this here beast cage and find me some worg pups. For that, I'll domesticate a worg for you!⟦5⟧
rows.quest:4729:completion:0: You got 'em at the perfect time, ⟦6⟧. Any later and they'd be untrainable! Gimmie a minute and I'll have the little fella ready for you to take home.
rows.quest:4734:obj:0: Use the Eggscilloscope Prototype on an egg in the Rookery.
rows.quest:4734:details:0: ⟦7⟧, I've been working hard on a new device, the eggscilloscope! It's designed to project a burst of cold energy at the egg of a black dragon... and freeze it solid! Can you test it for me?
rows.quest:4734:details:1: BI heard that high up in Blackrock Spire, the dragons have a rookery where they hatch their eggs. That's where you'll have to go to test the eggscilloscope, and then let me know how it worked!
rows.quest:4734:details:2: BAnd don't worry. Frozen dragon eggs should be harmless. It's the unfrozen ones you have to worry about!
rows.quest:4734:completion:0: It worked? Splendid! I knew it would!
rows.quest:4734:completion:1: BWhile you were gone I was working on a new version of the eggscilloscope. This one has a much longer range.
rows.quest:4734:completion:2: BHere, you can have one in case you go back to Blackrock Spire.
rows.quest:4735:obj:0: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:4735:details:0: ⟦8⟧, I'm finally ready for real samples of dragon eggs! Here, take this collectronic module. It's designed to extract a dragon egg and prepare it for transport. Go back to the Rookery and use the module to collect eggs.
rows.quest:4735:details:1: BAnd don't forget to freeze them first, or they might hatch before you can collect them!
rows.quest:4735:details:2: BWhen you have enough eggs, bring them to me!
rows.quest:4735:completion:0: Wow, you got them! The collectronic module worked! I'm a genius!
rows.quest:4735:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦9⟧. My patron will be very pleased to get these eggs...
rows.quest:4742:obj:0: Find the three gemstones of command: The Gemstone of Smolderthorn, Gemstone of Spirestone, and Gemstone of Bloodaxe. Return them, along with the Unadorned Seal of Ascension, to Vaelan.
rows.quest:4742:obj:1: BThe Generals, as told to you by Vaelan, are: War Master ⟦E5⟧ of the Smolderthorn; Highlord ⟦E6⟧ of the Spirestone; and Overlord Wyrmthalak of the Bloodaxe.
rows.quest:4742:details:0: As you can see, the unadorned seal has three empty sockets. Each of those sockets must be filled with a gemstone representing the leadership's command. Finally, Overlord Wyrmthalak, master of the lower citadel, must forge the seal in the flames of the Black Dragonflight.
rows.quest:4742:details:1: BUnderstand this, mortal: the chance that one of the three generals of the lower citadel would carry a gemstone at any given time is rare. You must be vigilant in your quest. Remain determined!
rows.quest:4742:completion:1: B<The pieces that you had collected have disappeared.>
rows.quest:4742:completion:2: BThe Unforged Seal of Ascension is now ready. It is time for the final step.
rows.quest:4743:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to the Wyrmbog in ⟦E7⟧. Find the ancient drake, Emberstrife and beat him without mercy until his will is broken.
rows.quest:4743:obj:1: BIt is at that moment which you must place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before the great beast. You must then be quick to use the Orb of Draconic Energy on his weakened form and claim dominion over his mental faculties. Control the beast and force the Flames of the Black Dragonflight upon the Unforged Seal of Ascension!
rows.quest:4743:details:0: Few of the black dragonkin, outside of those in the upper citadel, have the ability to forge the seal with their own flaming breath. Wyrmthalak is one such dragonkin, but his will is unbreakable.
rows.quest:4743:details:1: BYou must travel to the Wyrmbog in ⟦E7⟧. It is there that you will find an ancient drake known as Emberstrife. You must break his will, ⟦10⟧. Break it and use this orb on his weakened form. You will have scant seconds to control his mind and fan the flames that will forge the seal.
rows.quest:4743:completion:0: Stand steady while I cast the final invocation of protection.
rows.quest:4743:completion:1: B<Vaelan's eyes turn to twin orbs of flame.>
rows.quest:4743:completion:2: BThe Seal of Ascension is complete...
rows.quest:4743:completion:3: BKnow this, I have imbued the artifact with some powerful protective wards. In your darkest hour, when all appears to be lost, the might of the red flight will be at your disposal.
rows.quest:4764:obj:0: Bring Doomrigger's Clasp to Mayara Brightwing in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:4764:details:0: There is a chamber, high in Blackrock Spire, that was once called the Hall of Fortune. It was where the Dark Iron dwarves kept their relics, trophies and objects of art.
rows.quest:4764:details:1: BThat was long ago. It is said the hall has collapsed and is now used for... less savory tasks. But I believe some old dwarven relics may still be found there.
rows.quest:4764:details:2: BOne such relic is Doomrigger's clasp, with a surface so encrusted with rare gems that it was said to make weep any dwarf who gazes upon it.
rows.quest:4764:completion:0: You found it! So the rumors were true!
rows.quest:4764:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦12⟧. My patron, Count Remington Ridgewell, will be quite pleased to see this addition to this collection.
rows.quest:4765:obj:0: Bring Ridgewell's Crate to Remington Ridgewell in ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:4765:details:0: I have packaged Doomriggers Clasp into a crate, suitable for shipment to ⟦E8⟧. ⟦13⟧, you have been extremely helpful -- can I ask you for one last favor?
rows.quest:4765:details:1: BDeliver the crate to Count Remington Ridgewell. You will find him in the Keep of ⟦E8⟧. I am sure he'll be very pleased to see what you have for him.
rows.quest:4765:completion:0: Ah, so you are he! You have my thanks, ⟦14⟧. And... if you didn't already know... the gratitude of a noble in the house of Ridgewell is nigh worth a king's ransom.
rows.quest:4766:obj:0: Speak with Mayara Brightwing in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:4766:details:0: An agent of mine, Mayara Brightwing, was sent to the ⟦E4⟧ to scout the ruined city of Thaurissan. That destroyed city of the Dark Iron dwarves may hide objects of great value... objects that would fit nicely into our family museum.
rows.quest:4766:details:1: BMayara says she found something and will need aid in retrieving it, but it is not in Thaurissan. Instead, a foray into Blackrock Spire will be required.
rows.quest:4766:details:2: BI do not know the details, but if interested then speak with Mayara in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:4766:completion:0: You came from ⟦E8⟧? Wonderful -- I know of an object of art that Remington would kill to have in his museum, but extracting it won't be easy.
rows.quest:4768:obj:0: Bring the Darkstone Tablet to Shadow Mage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
rows.quest:4768:details:0: The Darkstone Tablet holds the writings of the long-dead dwarf Urheld Darkstone. An alchemist of great skill, he was thought insane by his contemporaries and, hence, did not share his research.
rows.quest:4768:details:1: BBut he did etch it onto tablets, and I believe one such tablet lies in Blackrock Spire, in a chamber once named the Hall of Fortune. I know not what it is now called, for few enter Blackrock and return.
rows.quest:4768:details:2: BBut if you are willing to brave its dangers and return to me with the tablet, your reward will be great.
rows.quest:4768:completion:0: Excellent. The formulae etched into this tablet will consume days of research, but I am confident such research will bear sweet fruit.
rows.quest:4768:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦15⟧. You have been invaluable to us.
rows.quest:4769:details:0: Vivian Lagrave sent me word from Kargath, in the ⟦E9⟧. Through her studies, she believes there is an ancient text within Blackrock Spire that would benefit our research. To confirm this, she will need someone to extract the text from the spire. No easy task.
rows.quest:4769:details:1: BIf interested, then speak with Vivian in Kargath.
rows.quest:4769:completion:0: It is true. I believe there is a tablet held within Blackrock Spire, a tablet that contains old alchemical recipes. I am glad you are here, for I need help in retrieving the tablet.
rows.quest:4769:completion:1: BMake yourself comfortable, and I will explain further.
rows.quest:4788:obj:0: Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:4788:details:0: While I look over the third and fourth tablets of Mosh'aru, you must find the fifth and sixth! It will not be easy, for they are held by the Smolderthorn trolls within Blackrock Spire. The spire is a dark mountain of fire between the ⟦E4⟧ and the ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:4788:details:1: BGood luck, ⟦16⟧. Blackrock Spire is no place for decent folk...
rows.quest:4788:completion:0: Unbelievable! You found them! You truly are a hero, ⟦17⟧!
rows.quest:4788:completion:1: BThat's a good thing, because I've been reading the tablets you brought me before, and from what I gathered... we're going to need a hero to stop what's coming...
rows.quest:4862:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Blackrock Spire and collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs for Kibler.
rows.quest:4862:obj:1: BBy the sound of it, these eggs could be found near spiders.⟦18⟧
rows.quest:4862:details:0: Believe it or not, there are people out there willing to pay for the most vile of domesticated beast!
rows.quest:4862:details:1: BI'd sent Bijou into the Spire to try and collect some of those spire spider eggs but I haven't heard from her in weeks. Maybe you can help me out?
rows.quest:4862:details:2: BI'll tell you what, ⟦19⟧. Go to Blackrock Spire and collect some spire spider eggs for me. Bring them back here and not only will I give you a little cash, but I'll even domesticate one for you!
rows.quest:4862:completion:0: What a load! I mean, look at all those eggs! These should bring in a right few gold.
rows.quest:4862:completion:1: BAs promised, here's your own little critter. Don't get bitten!
rows.quest:4866:obj:0: In the heart of Blackrock Spire you will find Mother Smolderweb. Engage her and get her to poison you. Chances are good that you will have to kill her as well. Return to Ragged John when you are poisoned so that he can 'milk' you.
rows.quest:4866:details:0: It's probably one of the most potent poisons in the world, ⟦20⟧!
rows.quest:4866:details:1: BI've overheard the Blackrock speaking about its lethality in my jaunts into the Spire. They call it 'Mother's Milk', named after Mother Smolderweb, the big nasty spider in the Skitterweb cave.
rows.quest:4866:details:2: BNow here's what I need from you: A live sample of the Milk, flowing through YOUR veins. Just bringing me the gland won't be enough! Get her to poison you and come back to me!
rows.quest:4866:details:3: BThen... I get to milk ya!
rows.quest:4866:details:4: B<Rubs his hands together in anticipation.>
rows.quest:4866:completion:0: This is gonna make the best ale yet!
rows.quest:4866:completion:1: BEh, what did you think I was gonna use this for? Poison or something??
rows.quest:4867:obj:0: Read Warosh's Scroll. Bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.
rows.quest:4867:details:1: BTake this note! Get me my mojo!
rows.quest:4867:completion:0: Aha! I can already feel my powers returning to me. And my mind is no longer wracked by Urok's curse.
rows.quest:4867:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦21⟧! Humility is below me, but I must acknowledge your aid.
rows.quest:4867:completion:2: BAnd I bid you fortune in your journeys through Blackrock Spire. You are a fool to think you could make your way to the top, but your bravery is without question.
rows.quest:4903:obj:0: Slay Highlord ⟦E6⟧, War Master ⟦E5⟧, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.
rows.quest:4903:details:0: By order of Warlord Goretooth, the following inhabitants of Blackrock Spire must be destroyed:
rows.quest:4903:details:2: BThe cruel and ruthless troll, War Master ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:4903:details:3: BOverlord Wyrmthalak, taskmaster of the lesser city.
rows.quest:4903:details:4: BYou will also be required to return any important documents that you may find.
rows.quest:4903:completion:0: <Warlord Goretooth's dull green skin turns a pasty white for a brief moment.>
rows.quest:4907:details:0: Hi, ⟦22⟧. Remember Tinkee Steamboil? Well, she remembers you! She sent me a message to keep an eye out for you, because... she needs your help again. I think it has something to do with her studies on dragons.
rows.quest:4907:details:1: BYou should speak to her in the ⟦E4⟧, at the Flame Crest.
rows.quest:4907:completion:0: Felnok was right! I do need your help again, and this time... it's going to be really dangerous.
rows.quest:4974:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief ⟦E12⟧ ⟦E13⟧. Take his head and return to ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:4974:details:0: ⟦E12⟧ dares make such grand claims because of the protection he is afforded by the black flight.
rows.quest:4974:details:1: BYou, ⟦23⟧, will find a way to pass through the Halls of Ascension. You will then find 'Warchief' ⟦E12⟧ ⟦E13⟧ and you will destroy him - FOR THE HORDE!
rows.quest:4974:details:2: B<Thrall slams a fist down upon his throne.>
rows.quest:4974:details:3: BThe next time you return to my chambers, you will hold his head high in triumph and then you shall present it to your Warchief. Do this and be honored as a hero of the ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:4974:completion:0: You have dealt a crippling blow to the forces of Blackrock, ⟦24⟧. With their Warchief slain, the Blackrock legion is once again thrown into the maw of chaos.
rows.quest:4974:completion:1: BIn honor of your heroics, the people of ⟦E16⟧ shall be rewarded!
rows.quest:4981:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.
rows.quest:4981:details:0: Never trust a goblin. That's what it comes down to, ⟦25⟧.
rows.quest:4981:details:1: BBijou is her name - one of our slipperiest operatives. I found out she was working for some shady exotic pet dealer out of the ⟦E4⟧ named Kibler, in essence, two timing us. Worse yet, she was using ⟦E15⟧ funds to finance her operations.
rows.quest:4981:details:2: BI want her brought back here alive.
rows.quest:4981:details:3: BShe was last seen entering Blackrock Spire. Find her and bring her back.
rows.quest:4981:details:4: BAnd ⟦26⟧, do not let her sweet talk you.
rows.quest:4981:completion:0: I won't lie to you, ⟦27⟧. I needed the money! Kibler pays very, very well - much better than the K.E.F. ever could.
rows.quest:4981:completion:1: BBut don't doubt my loyalties! Why do you think I'm down here? To get that crazy goblin some exotic animal eggs or something equally inane? No, only someone truly daft would come to Blackrock Spire to collect pets. Yep, I don't reckon too many people like that exist in this world.
rows.quest:4981:completion:3: BThe last thing we need are those kinds of people breeding.
rows.quest:4982:obj:0: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.⟦29⟧
rows.quest:4982:details:0: At night when this place is lightly guarded, I sneak around the city, taking notes and writing down anything I see that could be of some strategic value to the K.E.F.
rows.quest:4982:details:1: BLast night, however, things went dreadfully wrong. I stumbled across a tripwire and set off an alarm. I stashed my recon gear and ran for cover! Unfortunately, I can't get back to that gear. They've doubled and tripled up the patrols! All that information is lost.
rows.quest:4982:details:2: BGet my belongings back and I'll return to the K.E.F. peacefully.
rows.quest:4982:completion:0: You've done it! Once Lexlort has these plans, he'll forget all about the nasty things he wanted to do to me.
rows.quest:4983:obj:0: Take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report back to Grandmaster Lexlort in Kargath.⟦31⟧
rows.quest:4983:details:0: Take this report back to Lexlort. It will redeem my good name and will surely give the K.E.F. a strategic advantage in dealing with these orcs.
rows.quest:4983:details:1: BCome with you? I've got way too much work to do. Get going, they need these reports as soon as possible!⟦32⟧
rows.quest:4983:completion:0: I've got to hand it to her; she's managed to weasel her way out of another sticky situation! These reports will prove to be invaluable in our dealings with the Blackrock orcs.
rows.quest:4983:completion:1: BOf course, you will be rewarded for your hard work.
rows.quest:5001:obj:0: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. Good luck!⟦33⟧
rows.quest:5001:details:0: Ordinarily I don't deal with ⟦34⟧s but it seems that I'm stuck between a troll and a hard place. You see, my mission here is one of utmost importance to the ⟦E15⟧. The information I've discovered, however, applies to the well being of the ⟦E3⟧ as well. Now believe me, I'm no ⟦E3⟧ sympathizer, but the Blackrock threat is bigger than just a bunch of orcs.
rows.quest:5001:details:1: BYou help me out by finding my belongings and I'll help you out with some information that could prove useful to your kind.
rows.quest:5001:completion:0: Well I'll be! Where were they??
rows.quest:5002:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to the ⟦E4⟧ and give Bijou's Information to Marshal Maxwell.
rows.quest:5002:details:0: I'm a goblin of my word, ⟦35⟧. Now listen closely:
rows.quest:5002:details:1: BThese orcs are used primarily as beasts of burden and cannon fodder for the black dragonflight!
rows.quest:5002:details:2: BTheir true leader is none other than ⟦E17⟧, brood of ⟦E18⟧. I've also discovered the location of ⟦E17⟧'s subordinates in this part of the citadel.
rows.quest:5002:details:3: BTake this map to Marshal Maxwell in the ⟦E4⟧. It has the location of these fiends marked for easy identification.
rows.quest:5002:completion:0: This coincides with much of what we already knew. Regardless, it is interesting and rather unfortunate information.
rows.quest:5002:completion:1: BThe markings on this map will prove valuable in thinning the Blackrock menace.
rows.quest:5047:details:0: You'll find Malyfous Darkhammer in ⟦E19⟧, ⟦36⟧. Tell him that 'Finkle is A-OK' and that the suit works perfectly.
rows.quest:5047:details:2: B<Finkle hands you a glowing piece of flesh.>
rows.quest:5047:details:3: BI snatched it from the beast's innards during my 'vacation.'
rows.quest:5047:details:4: BI bet Malyfous could give you a fairly accurate assessment of what he can do with parts from a monster like this!
rows.quest:5047:details:5: BOh, I suppose you don't know where ⟦E19⟧ is, do you? To ⟦E20⟧, ⟦37⟧!
rows.quest:5047:completion:0: Alive? Suit worked? And what do we have here?
rows.quest:5081:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Blackrock Spire and destroy War Master ⟦E5⟧, Highlord ⟦E6⟧, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.
rows.quest:5081:details:0: This information fills in the gaps to our otherwise impeccable intelligence of Blackrock Spire.
rows.quest:5081:details:2: BFirst their war master, the troll ⟦E5⟧, must be destroyed. Without his battle plans, the Blackrock orcs will be thrown into chaos.
rows.quest:5081:details:3: BYou must then take out the ogre Highlord, ⟦E6⟧. The cowardly ogres of Blackrock are powerless without his leadership.
rows.quest:5081:details:4: BLastly, the overlord of the citadel: Wyrmthalak. With Wyrmthalak dead, their central command unit is without a conduit.
rows.quest:5081:completion:0: Excellent work, ⟦39⟧. At the very least, you have bought us more time - precious, precious time.
rows.quest:5089:obj:0: Take General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:5089:details:0: From the corpse of the defeated serpent you uncover what appears to be a note of some importance: A letter from his superior, General Drakkisath, concerning protocol.
rows.quest:5089:details:1: BYour instinct tells you that you should take it to Marshal Maxwell.
rows.quest:5102:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Blackrock Spire and destroy General Drakkisath. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.⟦40⟧
rows.quest:5102:details:0: We battle against these beasts on two fronts: From our capital of ⟦E8⟧ we fight them from the inside out and here, in the ⟦E4⟧, we take the battle to their doorstep. We must be vigilant, ⟦41⟧. None should be spared our wrath as none of our own were spared when they struck at our homes and families.
rows.quest:5102:details:1: BFind this General Drakkisath and destroy him!
rows.quest:5102:details:2: BThe task certainly will not be a simple one, but the rewards shall be extravagant.
rows.quest:5102:completion:0: Surely, we will strike against their dragon lords next. Well done, brave soldier of the ⟦E3⟧! Well done, indeed.
rows.quest:5127:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained.
rows.quest:5127:obj:1: BYou must also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate.
rows.quest:5127:obj:2: BReturn both the Soul Stained Pike and the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate to Lorax in ⟦E20⟧.
rows.quest:5127:details:0: Lorax makes deals, he does not accept them from insignificant mortals.
rows.quest:5127:details:1: BA deal I shall make with you, however... take this pike, it is imbued with powerful Fel energies. When you find Goraluk Anvilcrack, slay him and drive this pike through his dying heart. His soul he bartered, his soul I shall have. Return the pike and return the breastplate that the thief stole and I shall teach you what it is that he was to learn.
rows.quest:5127:completion:0: Our pact you did not break. The soul I did take. The reward I shall make.
rows.quest:5160:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to ⟦E20⟧ and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.
rows.quest:5160:details:0: ⟦E1⟧ to ⟦E16⟧, ⟦42⟧. Our flight makes its home in the frigid landscape of ⟦E20⟧. Once you reach ⟦E20⟧, find the caves of Mazthoril.
rows.quest:5160:details:1: BUpon the icy floors of Mazthoril you will find cobalt runes. Hold one of my scales and stand upon a rune and you shall be transported to Haleh, our matron protectorate.
rows.quest:5160:details:2: BGive her the scale so that she may scry what it is I have seen and felt, here in this doomed place.
rows.quest:5160:completion:0: The Aspects insist that we stay out of the affairs of mortals. In this world, however, such a thing is not always possible - especially when one of our own contemptuously disregards such edicts.
rows.quest:6502:obj:0: You must retrieve the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath. Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in Blackrock Spire.
rows.quest:6502:details:0: It is a piece of the dragon; a scale - enchanted and transformed. Whole, it could have granted access to the beast's lair. Shattered, it is useless.
rows.quest:6502:details:1: BIt is possible to repair the item, but to do so would require the blood of a black dragon champion. There is one... He is known as General Drakkisath, ruler of the dragonspawn armies of ⟦E17⟧. Perhaps you have heard of him?
rows.quest:6502:details:2: BReturn with his blood, ⟦43⟧, and I shall enchant the fragment into something that will grant you access to ⟦E21⟧'s lair.
rows.quest:6502:completion:0: This amulet will grant you the access that you seek. The lair of ⟦E21⟧ can be found in ⟦E7⟧. As long as you hold the amulet, her wards cannot prevent you from entering.
rows.quest:6502:completion:1: BThe Blue Flight wishes you luck, ⟦44⟧.
rows.quest:6569:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.
rows.quest:6569:details:0: So the ⟦45⟧ wishes to become one of the Black Flight, eh?
rows.quest:6569:details:1: BThe creation of the illusion you require is trivial, but the components required for the divination are quite difficult to obtain. The Warchief has entrusted you with this mission, so Myranda must assume you as capable.
rows.quest:6569:details:2: BTravel to the upper citadel of Blackrock Spire and slay enough of the black dragonspawn to fill up one of your packs with their eyes.
rows.quest:6569:details:3: BReturn to Myranda when you have gathered enough of the reagent.
rows.quest:6569:completion:1: BOh yes, these will do nicely.
rows.quest:6569:completion:2: BWith these reagents, Myranda will create for you a medallion that will grant an illusion capable of fooling the black dragonflight's gatekeeper.
rows.quest:6602:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood and return it to Rexxar.
rows.quest:6602:details:0: How would you feel about paying a visit to the General? No illusions, this time.
rows.quest:6602:details:1: BCeremony? A pretty word to describe the bloodletting that amuses the Black Dragonflight.
rows.quest:6602:details:2: BAll this amulet requires is the blood of General Drakkisath. Primitive security. There are other ways to receive the General's blood.
rows.quest:6602:details:3: BGo to Blackrock Spire and kill Drakkisath. Return with his blood and I will activate the key to ⟦E21⟧'s lair.
rows.quest:6602:completion:0: A victory that will be remembered for many years, ⟦47⟧. The Drakefire Amulet will open ⟦E21⟧'s lair. Gather your allies and bring victory to the ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:7761:obj:0: That is one stupid orc. It would appear as if you need to find this brand and gain the Mark of Drakkisath in order to access the Orb of Command.
rows.quest:7761:obj:1: BThe letter indicates that General Drakkisath guards the brand. Perhaps you should investigate.
rows.quest:7761:details:1: BI hold very little faith in your ability to prevent outsiders from accessing the master's lair. In the very likely event of your death, this orb has its own failsafe built in to prevent outsiders from teleporting directly into Blackwing.
rows.quest:7761:details:2: BOnly those with the Mark of Drakkisath branded upon their hand may make use of this orb. Thankfully, Drakkisath is not nearly as incompetent as you, Quartermaster. He guards the brand himself!
rows.quest:7761:completion:0: You don't even flinch as the smoldering brand is pressed into your flesh. You are so tough!
rows.quest:7761:completion:1: BYou now hold the Mark of Drakkisath. Have fun storming the castle.
rows.quest:8966:obj:0: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Mor Grayhoof and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
rows.quest:8966:details:0: My friend, Mor Grayhoof, was the first to fall victim to possession of a piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, and the corrupting spirit fragment that it contains. After stealing Valthalak's spellbook and amulet, we fled for our lives from the upper portion of Blackrock Spire. Along the way, Mor fell into the lower portion of the spire.
rows.quest:8966:details:1: BLater, we discovered that he survived the fall, only to be captured and tortured by War Master ⟦E5⟧. A few spectral assassins snuck in and slew him right in front of ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:8966:completion:0: You have done a great thing, ⟦48⟧. One spirit rests in peace, but there is still much work to be done before we can put all of this behind us.
rows.quest:8966:completion:1: BUnfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. But do not fear; in life I was a dabbler in the art of divination, so I have another task for you, which is going to enable us to ferret out the final piece.
rows.quest:8989:obj:0: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Mor Grayhoof and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
rows.quest:8989:details:0: My friend, Mor Grayhoof, was the first to fall victim to possession of a piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, and the corrupting spirit fragment that it contains. After stealing Valthalak's spellbook and amulet, we fled for our lives from the upper portion of Blackrock Spire. Along the way, Mor fell into the lower portion of the spire.
rows.quest:8989:details:1: BLater, we discovered that he survived the fall, only to be captured and tortured by War Master ⟦E5⟧. A few spectral assassins snuck in and slew him right in front of ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:8989:completion:0: Thank you for helping Mor Grayhoof, ⟦49⟧. Another spirit rests in peace, and we now have the reassembled amulet! But we still have the hardest test ahead of us.
rows.quest:8989:completion:1: BIn order for the brazier to be attuned to calling forth Lord Valthalak, there are a few more items that need to be gathered and brought back to me here.
rows.quest:8995:obj:0: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon Lord Valthalak. Dispatch him, and use Lord Valthalak's Amulet on the corpse. Then, return Lord Valthalak's Amulet to the Spirit of Lord Valthalak.
rows.quest:8995:details:1: BWhen alive, Lord Valthalak used to inhabit what is now The Beast's chamber. Go there and use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth Lord Valthalak. It will reincorporate him, so he'll have to be killed again. I'd take care of The Beast first, and be sure take enough friends along to survive the upper portion of Blackrock Spire.
rows.quest:8995:details:2: BOnce you've dispatched Valthalak, use the amulet on his corpse. With his spirit reunified, he'll likely want his amulet back, as well.
rows.quest:8995:completion:0: How fortunate for you that I know you're not part of the original group that stole this from me.
rows.quest:8995:completion:1: BI'll take back what is mine now, mortal! Give the amulet to me!
